workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.title: Original session observations
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.intro: Connect to the original task session and save this load's observations.
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.unavailabl: Load the current account and project first.
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.denied: Session observations are unavailable to this account
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.denied_hin: Protected content has been removed. Read again with current access to the original session.
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.read_faile: Current records could not be read. Existing observations retain their original content and time; read again.
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.coverage: Coverage is unverified. This observation does not establish complete session history or task completion.
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.original_h: Keep the original request and operation identifier. Checking it will not connect and load again.
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.conflict: The source or version changed. Read current records before explicitly connecting again.
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.command_fa: The load request could not be confirmed. Check current access and records.
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.not_loaded: No session load has been recorded. Reading saved records does not connect to WorkBuddy.
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.overdue_hi: The load deadline passed without final confirmation. Check the original record; it will not reconnect automatically.
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.error_work: The original session is unavailable. Saved observations remain subject to current access.
The connection or load was interrupted. Its saved prefix is not complete history.
This load reached its entry or text limit. Saved records are retained.
This load was rejected. Check the current source and access.
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.previous_r: The previous confirmed observation is retained:
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.page_faile: Saved entries could not be read. Existing records are retained; read again.
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.empty_load: This load was confirmed without saved displayable entries. This does not establish that no requests are pending.
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.no_saved_e: This load has no saved displayable entries yet.
workbuddy-cloud-collaboration.unsupporte: This entry type is not supported for display.
